requirements.description: CRSP monthly stock returns, price, and shares outstanding for portfolio returns (ret), market equity (|prc| x shrout), and buy-and-hold lagged returns (BHRET6, BHRET36).

CRSP monthly header records with point-in-time validity windows for the universe filter: ordinary common shares (hshrcd 10/11), major exchanges (hexcd 1/2/3), and the nonfinancial exclusion (hsiccd outside 6000-6999).
CRSP monthly delisting returns and codes so portfolio returns incorporate delisting events (dlret with dlstcd to identify performance-driven delistings; dlstdt is the delisting date).

CRSP-Compustat (CCM) link table joining CRSP permno to Compustat gvkey with link validity windows and primary-link flags (lpermno -> gvkey; filter linkprim='P', linktype in ('LU','LC'), usedflag=1, linkdt <= date <= linkenddt).

Compustat annual industrial fundamentals for every accounting variable: total assets (at, data6) for ASSETG and the balance-sheet decomposition; book equity inputs (ceq, seq, txdb, pstkrv/pstkl/pstk); BM/EP/ROA/Leverage inputs (sale, oibdp, dltt, dlc, prcc_f, csho); ACCRUALS inputs (act, ch, lct, dlc, txp, dp); NOA inputs (at, ch, dlc, dltt, mib[minority interest=data38], pstk, ceq); CI inputs (capx, sale); decomposition components (ch=#1, act=#4, ppegt=#8, re=#36, dltt=#9, dlc=#34, ceq=#60, pstk=#130, mib=#38). sich provides the four-digit SIC for the financial-firm exclusion.

Monthly Fama-French three-factor model factors (Mkt-RF, SMB, HML) plus the risk-free rate for the Table II Panel C/D three-factor alphas. There is no dedicated three_factor_monthly table in the ff database (ff.three_factor is daily, 26110 rows); the monthly FF3 factors are taken as the Mkt-RF/SMB/HML/RF subset of the four-factor monthly table (MOM dropped).
Monthly Carhart four-factor model factors (Mkt-RF, SMB, HML, MOM) plus the risk-free rate for the four-factor robustness alphas reported in the paper (Section II).
